definition: a tall upright post of stone
description: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.
